import json,numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from pathlib import Path

def cloud(folder,c,mask=None):
    p=Path(folder); m=json.loads((p/'meta.json').read_text())['cameras'][c]
    d=np.load(p/('depth_'+c+'.npy')).astype(float)
    im=np.array(Image.open(p/'last'/ (c+'.jpg')))
    K=np.array(m['intrinsic_cv']); M=np.array(m['cam2world_gl'])
    v,u=np.indices(d.shape)
    q=np.stack([(u-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1],-d],-1)
    w=q@M[:3,:3].T+M[:3,3]
    return im,w
if __name__=='__main__':
    import sys
    for c in ['front','left','right','topview']:
        im,w=cloud(sys.argv[1],c)
        m=(im[:,:,2]>100)&(im[:,:,0]<80)&(im[:,:,1]<100)
        pts=w[m]
        print(c,len(pts), 'median',np.median(pts,0) if len(pts) else [],'bounds',np.quantile(pts,[.1,.9],axis=0) if len(pts) else [])
